You don't say whether you let it 'restart to update'. Did you? Have you rebooted the computer? Does Thunderbird otherwise work as it should?

If the answer to all those is Yes, I'd blame the symptoms on a botched upgrade. I'd try the following (make a backup copy of your Thunderbird Profile first; see <https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/thunderbird-export> for how to do that):

- Download the installer for the same version from <https://www.thunderbird.net/en-US/thunderbird/all/> and install it over the current installation.

- If that doesn't improve the situation I'd uninstall the current version, reboot the computer, then reinstall Thunderbird.
